units.title: Prominent fashion illustrators
uos: 1.a. Appreciate the style of drawing, rendering and body proportion adopted by prominent fashion illustrator

units.title: Style and techniques of Fashion illustrators
topics: 2.1. Select any well known illustrators work and copy it with the same mediums and techniques used by the illustrator
uos: 2.a. Copy the style technique and medium used by the specific fashion illustrator

units.title: Fashion icons
topics: 3.1. Take reference images on any one fashion icon (fashion personality) and make a range of illustrations based on his/her characteristics
uos: 3.a. Translate the stylistic information from a personality into an illustrated style

units.title: Rendering of materials
topics: 4.1. Procure garments made out of specific materials and render it while observing it on a dress foam (dummy) in unidirectional light; for example: satin, silk, denim, leather, corduroy, translucent cotton (mulmul) chiffon and georgette (use appropriate medium and technique suitable to the quality of the fabric)

units.title: Media exploration
topics: 5.1. Representing fabric quality , surface embellishments, prints, and details for menswear, women’s wear and kids wear using different mediums like; pencil crayons, aquarelles, felt-tip pens, watercolors etc.
uos: 5.a. Render surface embellishments on men, women and kids wear

units.title: Short hand representation 6a Represent fabric qualities in least possible time and strokes
topics: 6.1. Quick rendering of representing fabric qualities, colour, surface embellishments, and other details like light and shade.
6.2. Use methods like cross hatching, diagonal strokes, smudging, using washes etc to generate the effects.
